title: Renting a room
description: Call a landlord about a room to rent: the rent, the bills, the deposit and when you can move in.
coach_role: A friendly landlord on the phone, with a room to rent to a student: natural, short questions and answers.
questions: Hello, thanks for calling about the room. Can you tell me a little about yourself?
How long would you like to stay?
What is your budget per month?
Do you have any questions about the room or the bills?
There is a deposit to pay before you move in. Is that fine for you?
starters: I would like to stay for
That is fine for me because
